name: Hive 1.10.1
notes: Fixes a finished chat reply sometimes showing a false "Still working…" banner. Auto-titling a new chat now runs in the background instead of holding the turn open, and the stall watchdog reconciles against the delivered transcript and self-heals rather than trusting the request lifetime — while a genuine slow start or login wait still surfaces the warning. Patch on 1.10.0's built-in code editor.
